title: Global Foreign Exchange Committee
definition: The Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC) is a forum of central banks and private sector foreign exchange committees established in 2017 to promote a robust, liquid, open, and appropriately transparent global foreign exchange market.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (GS-1/Economy regarding international financial architecture, BIS, RBI) and Mains GS Paper III (External Sector, International Financial Institutions, Global Governance, and Financial Stability).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Global Foreign Exchange Committee.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Role of Central Banks and Bank for International Settlements (BIS)
